title: Runnable agent + FastAPI + local-fake adapter
acceptance_criterion: Normal task completes; missing evidence produces a supported refusal; failed tool is visible
stdout:
Phase 1 shipped. LLMAdapter ABC with deterministic local-fake (scripted from fixtures/llm/) and
minimax adapters behind a factory. Fixed LangGraph workflow: retrieve -> classify -> (answer |
refuse | clarify). FastAPI surface with HS256 JWT; async worker via concurrent.futures. Mock
ticket ledger is idempotent on action_key. Streamlit skeleton present.

Note: the 3 review criticals called out on the import PR (JWT secret startup guard, alg
allowlist, run-usage persistence) and finding F01 (approved_by from the JWT, not the body)
were fixed in PR #8, after the original standalone-repo build.
evidence: src/agentops_workbench/api/server.py exposes POST /v1/runs, GET /v1/runs/{id}, POST /v1/runs/{id}/cancel, POST /v1/actions
tests/test_api_runs.py = 15 tests, tests/llm/test_factory.py = 4, tests/llm/test_local_fake_adapter.py = 3, tests/worker/test_runner.py = 2 — all pass
src/agentops_workbench/mocks/tickets.py — idempotent mock ledger (dedupes on action_key, rejects mutated args)
PR #8 added the JWT secret startup guard + HS-family algorithm allowlist (tests/test_auth_hardening.py)

synthesized.note: The /dev-kit:build runner was never executed in this monorepo. The AgentOps Workbench was built in a standalone repo and imported via PR #8, so no per-step sub-agent subprocess output was ever captured. This file is reconstructed from the shipped artifacts under apps/agentops-workbench/ plus a re-run of the deterministic gates on 2026-09-11. exit_code / acceptance_met are judgements against the shipped tree, not a recorded process exit.
